rules: Dedupe within the current batch, not just against the archive: 7/20 rejects (35%) were exact in-run duplicates, including 3 variants of TS_MEAN(($close-$low)/denom, 10) that only swapped the denominator (CS_RANK($dollar_volume), TS_STD($return,21), LOG($dollar_volume)).

Stop crossing CS_RANK($earnings_per_share) * X for any X: 4 rejects this round took that exact shape (vs TS_STD($close,126), vs TS_RANK($close-$high,63), vs CS_RANK($volume), vs TS_RANK($high,21)). EPS still works as a ratio numerator: RANK($earnings_per_share/($book_per_share+1e-8)) accepted at 3.909.

RANK($eps) combined with any close-high/close-low intraday-position ratio is saturated regardless of operator: both a minus form and a times form hit archive_subtree, sharing 8-10 nodes with an existing member.

Crossover children need a real multi-node subtree from their parent: two CS_RANK($eps)*X proposals were rejected as crossover_not_a_fusion for sharing only the 2-node CS_RANK($eps) wrapper with a TS_CORR($return,$volume,...) parent.

Don't just flip the outer operator on a pair accepted earlier the same round: CS_RANK(TS_STD($return,5))*TS_RANK($dollar_volume,63) was accepted at 1.763; its minus variant was rejected right after as archive_subtree (4 shared nodes).

$book_per_share paired with a second fundamental gave this round's top fitness (4.326, bare CS_RANK($book_per_share)*CS_RANK($roa), no ratio) plus two more accepts (3.909, 2.171 as a ratio denominator); try it next with leverage, operating_margin, or asset_turnover.
MAX/MIN(fundamental, 0) truncation extended beyond eps this round: accrual_gap, roe, and roa all accepted with it. Still untried: leverage, operating_margin, asset_turnover, book_per_share.

Guarded-ratio chassis on DELAY-lagged fields is saturated at the wrapper level: TS_STD($open/(DELAY($close,21)+1e-8),10) shared 7 nodes with the archived TS_MEAN version of the same payload. Swapping only the outer TS aggregator doesn't dodge archive_subtree.
